nodes.natural_language: The function $f(n)$ is defined on the positive integers and takes non-negative integer values. $f(2)=0,f(3)>0,f(9999)=3333$ and for all $m,n:$$ f(m+n)-f(m)-f(n)=0 \text{ or } 1. $Determine $f(1982)$. Show that it is 660.
